name: com.ggtools.tmproultilitis
description: Provides high-level text utilities for TextMeshProUGUI, including controlled typewriter effects, tag-aware parsing, and automated pagination through <page> markers. Also ships Mobile Input Preview: an iOS/Android style bar that floats above the native touch keyboard and mirrors what is being typed into the selected TMP_InputField, with a blinking caret and a Done button. Features coroutine management per text field, word-safe page splitting, and graceful fallback behavior. Suitable for dialogue UIs, notifications, tutorials, and interfaces requiring interactive text rendering.
